title: DocumentManifest
description: Triage decision for one publication: is it in scope, and which individuals does it describe?

in_scope.description: True if the document describes at least one individual human with a stated/suspected/revised diagnosis in the disease scope, with phenotypic, biochemical or genetic findings.

document_type.description: case_report: 1 individual; case_series: 2+ individuals described individually; cohort_with_individual_data: per-patient table/rows; cohort_summary_only: pooled statistics without per-patient data (out of scope for records, in scope for a later cohort summary); review_with_case: review that embeds a new case; review_of_published_cases: tabulates previously published cases (their citations matter); family_study: pedigree with several affected relatives.

reasons.description: One or two sentences justifying the decision.

scope_diseases_mentioned.description: Disease names in the disease scope that the document is about.

local_id.description: Identifier as used in the paper. Use 'the patient' when a single unnamed patient is described.

where.description: Anchors where this individual's data live: 'abstract', 'sec:<n>', 'tab:<n> r<i>' (row-wise) or 'tab:<n> c<j>' (column-wise).

is_affected.description: False for unaffected relatives mentioned only for context.

case_type.description: Why this individual was reported, as the authors frame it: a typical presentation (teaching/illustrative case), an atypical or unusual presentation, a novel variant or genotype, a treatment or response report, a diagnostic odyssey or prior misdiagnosis, a complication or long-term natural history, or a screening-detected (asymptomatic) case. Records reporting bias for later analyses.

case_type_reason.description: Short phrase from the paper supporting case_type (e.g. 'first report of', 'unusual presentation', 'detected by newborn screening').

is_rereport.description: True if the paper states this individual was described in an earlier publication.

rereport_reference.description: Citation text or PMID of the earlier report.

cited_case_references.description: For reviews/series that tabulate previously published cases: the citation strings (or PMIDs) of those earlier reports, for harvest-completeness checks.
